California Secretary of State 2026 General Election media JSON bulk files.
Discovery: https://sos.ca.gov/media
Endpoints listed in: https://media.sos.ca.gov/media/json-endpoints.csv
Bulk files: https://media.sos.ca.gov/media/<office>.json
Fetched: 2026-10-27
Trimmed to selected statewide and districtwide contests.
2024 general data was published as Statement of Vote PDF/XLSX only; the live
media JSON files are overwritten per election and currently carry 2026 data.
